items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) did not practice for the second straight day. McVay noted he is not making great progress.
items.why: Hip injury; limited progress per coach
items.implication: Likely OUT or game-time; elevated Adams role continues
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Davante Adams (42% tgt share sans Nacua historically)

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) did not practice for the second straight day.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 3; Schultz target share spiked prior
items.opportunity: TE/WR targets to Dalton Schultz and others

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery (MCL/PCL/meniscus; ACL intact). Season-ending for regular season; possible playoff return.
items.why: Knee damage requiring surgery ending 2026 regular season
items.implication: Jameis Winston full-time starter; impacts Giants pass-catchers volume/efficiency

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) missed practice for second straight day; looking like he misses second consecutive game. Brazil travel factor.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated from Aug 20 origin; incomplete practices since Week 1 big half
items.opportunity: Target share to Mark Andrews, Ja'Kobi Lane if available

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs Bears. Limited participation likely.
items.why: Good MRI; suited up and participating (cowboy collar)
items.implication: Should start MNF; monitor workload vs backups Bigsby/Shipley who DNPed
items.opportunity: Full role if cleared; handcuff value if limited

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): Highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak rush defense + high prop
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs poor DAL run D

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% tgt share both games; RB7 utilization. PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.

HATE Travis Etienne (low snap/touch share even with Kamara); Rhamondre Stevenson (low snaps post-fumble, tough JAX run D); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (worst WR fantasy D, low team total). Jonathon Brooks to IR elevates Chuba Hubbard to lead back.
items.why: Poor roles/matchups; Brooks IR confirms Hubbard lead
items.opportunity: Hubbard clear lead with Dillon backup

items.text: Interesting TNF spot: Is Michael Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London and Kyle Pitts? Penix starting vs Packers.
items.why: Penix return from knee could unlock pass game after zero red-zone trips
items.opportunity: Improved QB play for ATL weapons

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua, targeted on 60 (42%). Results: 5-35-3 vs JAX 2025 and 8-195-2 vs NYG this week. Smash if Nacua out again.
items.why: Historical route/target share and recent production without Nacua
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 upside while Nacua sidelined
items.opportunity: 42% target share, high routes in Nacua absences

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; aggravated after 5-150-1 Week 1 half. Hasn't practiced full since; Ravens travel to Brazil.
items.why: Injury origin and incomplete recovery plus travel

items.text: LOVE Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt sans Collins, IND allows 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, high RZ); Brock Purdy vs ARI (high implied total, weak ARI secondary).
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz targets; Watson RZ; Purdy volume

items.text: Has Marshawn Lloyd totally blown his chance and ceded Packers backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Monitor TNF snaps.
items.why: Usage concerns; possible cede to Johnson

items.text: Does Jayden Reed absence lead to more 2-TE sets for Packers? Can OL hold for Christian Watson and Matthew Golden to cook?
items.why: Reed out potentially increases 2TE and WR opportunities for Watson
